# GENERATED by gearbox <version> -- do not edit. Run `gearbox generate` to regenerate.

server:
  home_dir: ~/.cf-gears/integration-demo/local
database:
  servers:
    pg:
      engine: postgres
      host: 127.0.0.1
      port: 55442
      user: integration
      password: ${GEARS_PG_PASSWORD}
      params:
        sslmode: disable
oop_http:
  listen_addr: 127.0.0.1:8090
  advertise_uri: http://127.0.0.1:8090
  allow_loopback_advertise: true
  internal_auth:
    peer_name: integration-demo-platform
    provider: shared_secret
    secret: ${TOOLKIT_PLATFORM_SECRET}
gears:
  api-contracts-consumer:
    config:
      consumer_wiring:
        api-contracts:
          critical: true
  authn-resolver:
    config: {}
  cluster:
    config:
      profiles:
        event-broker:
          cache:
            provider: standalone
  grpc-hub:
    config:
      internal_auth:
        peer_name: integration-demo-platform
        provider: shared_secret
        secret: ${TOOLKIT_PLATFORM_SECRET}
      internal_auth_enforcement: required
      listen_addr: uds://~/.cf-gears/integration-demo/local/run/checkout/grpc-hub.sock
      strict_socket_dir: true
  oidc-authn-plugin:
    config:
      http_client:
        custom_ca_certificate_paths:
        - oidc-ca/ca.crt
      jwt:
        claim_mapping:
          subject_id: sub
          subject_tenant_id: tenant_id
          token_scopes: scope
        expected_audience:
        - integration-demo
        trusted_issuers:
        - issuer: https://localhost:58443
      s2s_oauth:
        default_subject_type: gts.cf.core.security.subject_user.v1~
        discovery_url: https://localhost:58443
  types-registry:
    database:
      server: pg
      dbname: types_registry
    config:
      {}

# GENERATED by gearbox <version> -- do not edit. Run `gearbox generate` to regenerate.

server:
  home_dir: ~/.cf-gears/integration-demo/local
database:
  servers:
    pg:
      engine: postgres

      port: 55442
      user: integration

      params:
        sslmode: disable
internal_auth:
  peer_name: integration-demo-platform
  provider: shared_secret
  secret: ${TOOLKIT_PLATFORM_SECRET}
gears:
  api-contracts-consumer:
    runtime:
      type: oop
      execution:
        executable_path: <gears-rust>/target/debug/gbx-checkout
        args:
        - --config
        - config/checkout.yaml
    config:
      {}
  api-gateway:
    config:
      bind_addr: 127.0.0.1:8087
      enable_docs: true
      gateway_proxy:
        directory_endpoint: uds://~/.cf-gears/integration-demo/local/run/flight-control/grpc-hub.sock
        enabled: true
      internal_advertise_uri: http://127.0.0.1:8088
      internal_auth:
        peer_name: integration-demo-platform
        provider: shared_secret
        secret: ${TOOLKIT_PLATFORM_SECRET}
      internal_bind_addr: 127.0.0.1:8088
      public:
        exposed_only: true
  authn-resolver:
    config: {}
  authz-resolver:
    runtime:
      type: oop
      execution:
        executable_path: <gears-rust>/target/debug/gbx-payments
        args:
        - --config
        - config/payments.yaml
    config:
      {}
  grpc-hub:
    config:
      internal_auth:
        peer_name: integration-demo-platform
        provider: shared_secret
        secret: ${TOOLKIT_PLATFORM_SECRET}
      internal_auth_enforcement: required
      listen_addr: uds://~/.cf-gears/integration-demo/local/run/flight-control/grpc-hub.sock
      strict_socket_dir: true
  oidc-authn-plugin:
    config:
      http_client:
        custom_ca_certificate_paths:
        - oidc-ca/ca.crt
      jwt:
        claim_mapping:
          subject_id: sub
          subject_tenant_id: tenant_id
          token_scopes: scope
        expected_audience:
        - integration-demo
        trusted_issuers:
        - issuer: https://localhost:58443
      s2s_oauth:
        default_subject_type: gts.cf.core.security.subject_user.v1~
        discovery_url: https://localhost:58443
  service-discovery:
    config:
      registrar_gears:
        authz-resolver:
        - api-contracts
      trusted_registrars:
      - integration-demo-platform
  types-registry:
    database:
      server: pg
      dbname: types_registry
    config:
      {}
